segs.pali: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā videhesu cārikaṃ carati mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi. Tena kho pana samayena brahmāyu brāhmaṇo mithilāyaṃ paṭivasati jiṇṇo vuḍḍho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto, vīsavassasatiko jātiyā, tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ, padako, veyyākaraṇo, lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo. Assosi kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo – ‘‘samaṇo khalu bho, gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito videhesu cārikaṃ carati mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi. Taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato – ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti. So imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti. So dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ, kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti. Sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotī’’’ti.
segs.zh: 如是我闻：一时，世尊与约五百位比丘组成的大比丘僧团一起，游行于韦德哈国。那时，[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜婆罗门住在弥提罗城。他已年老、耄耋、寿高，已达暮年，生于世间已一百二十岁。他精通三吠陀，兼通词汇、仪轨、音韵、语词解说及古史传说为第五支；善解文句，通晓语法，于顺世论及大人相无不精达。[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜婆罗门听说：“诸位朋友，释迦子[[gotama|沙门乔达摩]]从释迦族出家，与约五百位比丘组成的大比丘僧团一起，正游行于韦德哈国。关于那位[[gotama|乔达摩尊]]者的美好名声已这样传扬开来：‘彼世尊是阿拉汉、正自觉者、明行足、善逝、世间解、无上士调御丈夫、天人师、佛陀、世尊。他亲自觉悟、现证之后，向这个包含天、魔、梵天的世界，以及包含沙门、婆罗门、天人众的世代宣说。他所教导的法，初善、中善、后善，义理完备、言辞圆满，他所宣示的是完全圆满、完全清净的梵行。能见到这样的阿拉汉，实在是好啊。’”

segs.pali: Tena kho pana samayena brahmāyussa brāhmaṇassa uttaro nāma māṇavo antevāsī hoti tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ, padako, veyyākaraṇo, lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo. Atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo uttaraṃ māṇavaṃ āmantesi – ‘‘ayaṃ, tāta uttara, samaṇo gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito videhesu cārikaṃ carati mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi. Taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato – ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho…pe… sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotī’ti. Ehi tvaṃ, tāta uttara, yena samaṇo gotamo tenupasaṅkama; upasaṅkamitvā samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ jānāhi yadi vā taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ tathā santaṃyeva saddo abbhuggato, yadi vā no tathā; yadi vā so bhavaṃ gotamo tādiso, yadi vā na tādiso. Tathā mayaṃ taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ vedissāmā’’ti. ‘‘Yathā kathaṃ panāhaṃ, bho, taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ jānissāmi yadi vā taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ tathā santaṃyeva saddo abbhuggato, yadi vā no tathā; yadi vā so bhavaṃ gotamo tādiso, yadi vā na tādiso’’ti. ‘‘Āgatāni kho, tāta uttara, amhākaṃ mantesu dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇāni, yehi samannāgatassa mahāpurisassa dveyeva gatiyo bhavanti anaññā . Sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, rājā hoti cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato. Tassimāni satta ratanāni bhavanti, seyyathidaṃ – cakkaratanaṃ, hatthiratanaṃ, assaratanaṃ, maṇiratanaṃ, itthiratanaṃ, gahapatiratanaṃ, pariṇāyakaratanameva sattamaṃ. Parosahassaṃ kho panassa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīraṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā. So imaṃ pathaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati. Sace kho pana agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati, arahaṃ hoti sammāsambuddho loke vivaṭṭacchado. Ahaṃ kho pana, tāta uttara, mantānaṃ dātā; tvaṃ mantānaṃ paṭiggahetā’’ti.
segs.zh: 那时，[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜婆罗门有一位名叫优多罗的青年弟子。他也精通三吠陀，以及词汇表、礼仪书、音韵论、语词解说，并及作为第五支的古老传说；善于文句，通达语法，于顺世论与大人相无不精通。于是，[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜婆罗门招呼优多罗青年，说道：“亲爱的优多罗，这位释迦子[[gotama|沙门乔达摩]]从释迦族出家，正与约五百位比丘组成的大比丘僧团一起，游行于韦德哈国。关于那位[[gotama|乔达摩尊]]者的美好名声已如此传扬：‘彼世尊是阿拉汉、正自觉者……能见到这样的阿拉汉，实在是好。’去吧，亲爱的优多罗，你去见[[gotama|沙门乔达摩]]。见过之后，你须了解[[gotama|沙门乔达摩]]，看看那位[[gotama|乔达摩尊]]者的名声是否确实如其传闻，或并非如此；他本人是否即是那般，抑或并非那般。如此，我们便能了解那位[[gotama|乔达摩尊]]者了。”“然而，先生，我究竟应如何了解那位[[gotama|乔达摩尊]]者——哪些方面确实如此、名声不虚，哪些方面并非如此；他具足哪些特征为那般，哪些又不是呢？”“亲爱的优多罗，在我们的圣典中，记载了三十二大人相。凡具足这些大人相者，只有两种可能，别无其他道路。如果他过在家生活，便成为转轮王，一位法王，以正法治理天下，征服四方，国土安稳，具足七宝。他的七宝即是：轮宝、象宝、马宝、摩尼宝、女宝、居士宝、将军宝为第七。他有超过一千个儿子，个个勇健英武，能摧破敌军。他不用棍棒、不用刀剑，唯以正法征服这大地至于海际而安住。但他若从家出家、过无家的生活，便成为阿拉汉、正自觉者，在世间揭开覆障者。亲爱的优多罗，我是圣典的传授者，你是圣典的领受者。”

segs.pali: ‘‘Evaṃ, bho’’ti kho uttaro māṇavo brahmāyussa brāhmaṇassa paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā brahmāyuṃ brāhmaṇaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā videhesu yena bhagavā tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi. Anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi. Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho uttaro māṇavo bhagavato kāye dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇāni samannesi. Addasā kho uttaro māṇavo bhagavato kāye dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇāni, yebhuyyena thapetvā dve. Dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati – kosohite ca vatthaguyhe, pahūtajivhatāya ca. Atha kho bhagavato etadahosi – ‘‘passati kho me ayaṃ uttaro māṇavo dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇāni , yebhuyyena thapetvā dve. Dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati – kosohite ca vatthaguyhe, pahūtajivhatāya cā’’ti. Atha kho bhagavā tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāsi yathā addasa uttaro māṇavo bhagavato kosohitaṃ vatthaguyhaṃ. Atha kho bhagavā jivhaṃ ninnāmetvā ubhopi kaṇṇasotāni anumasi paṭimasi ; ubhopi nāsikasotāni anumasi paṭimasi; kevalampi nalāṭamaṇḍalaṃ jivhāya chādesi. Atha kho uttarassa māṇavassa etadahosi – ‘‘samannāgato kho samaṇo gotamo dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇehi. Yaṃnūnāhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ anubandheyyaṃ, iriyāpathamassa passeyya’’nti. Atha kho uttaro māṇavo sattamāsāni bhagavantaṃ anubandhi chāyāva anapāyinī .
segs.zh: “是的，尊者。”优多罗青年应答[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜婆罗门后，从座而起，向[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜婆罗门行礼，右绕之后，便朝着世尊所在的韦德哈方向游行而去。他次第游历，一路前行，来到世尊之处。抵达后，与世尊欢喜问讯，叙说欣悦、感念的话语，而后坐于一旁。坐于一傍的优多罗青年，在世尊身上逐一观察三十二大人相。优多罗青年看见，世尊身上的三十二大人相大多清晰可见，唯有二相尚不能断定。他对这二相感到犹豫、疑惑，心中不能决了、无法确知——是哪二相呢？即是“阴藏隐秘相”与“广长舌相”。那时，世尊心中思惟：“这位优多罗青年已观察到我身上大部分的三十二大人相，仅余二相未曾得见。他对这二相犹豫、疑惑，不能决了，无法确知——即阴藏隐秘相与广长舌相。”于是，世尊便运起神通，作出如是变化，令优多罗青年清楚得见世尊那隐于皮下的阴藏相。接着，世尊出广长舌，以舌触抚两侧耳孔，又以舌触抚两侧鼻孔，更以整片舌相遍覆整个额头区域。那时，优多罗青年心想：“[[gotama|沙门乔达摩]]确已具足三十二大人相。既然如此，我何不随在[[gotama|沙门乔达摩]]身后，仔细瞻视他行、住、坐、卧等一切威仪呢？”于是，优多罗青年便如影随形一般，跟随世尊七个月，须臾不离。

segs.pali: Atha kho uttaro māṇavo sattannaṃ māsānaṃ accayena videhesu yena mithilā tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi. Anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena mithilā yena brahmāyu brāhmaṇo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā brahmāyuṃ brāhmaṇaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho uttaraṃ māṇavaṃ brahmāyu brāhmaṇo etadavoca – ‘‘kacci, tāta uttara, taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ tathā santaṃyeva saddo abbhuggato , no aññathā? Kacci pana so bhavaṃ gotamo tādiso, no aññādiso’’ti? ‘‘Tathā santaṃyeva, bho, taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saddo abbhuggato, no aññathā; tādisova so bhavaṃ gotamo, no aññādiso. Samannāgato ca so bhavaṃ gotamo dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇehi.
segs.zh: 七个月过去后，优多罗学童离开韦德哈国，向弥提罗城方向游行。他次第游行，渐渐抵达弥提罗，来到[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜婆罗门处，行礼后退坐一面。[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜婆罗门对退坐一面的优多罗学童说：“亲爱的优多罗，那位[[gotama|乔达摩尊]]者的声誉是否如传闻所说，真实不虚？他本人是否确如传闻那般，并无二致？”优多罗答道：“先生，那位[[gotama|乔达摩尊]]者的声誉，正如传闻所说，真实不虚；他本人正是如此，毫无差别。那位[[gotama|乔达摩尊]]者确实具足三十二大人相。”

segs.pali: ‘‘Suppatiṭṭhitapādo kho pana bhavaṃ gotamo; idampi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
segs.zh: “那位[[gotama|乔达摩尊]]者的双足安立平正——这即是那位[[gotama|乔达摩尊]]者作为大人所具足的大人相。”

segs.pali: ‘‘Heṭṭhā kho pana tassa bhoto gotamassa pādatalesu cakkāni jātāni sahassārāni sanemikāni sanābhikāni sabbākāraparipūrāni…
segs.zh: “再者，那位[[gotama|乔达摩]]尊者的足掌之下，生有千辐轮相，轮缘、轮毂悉皆具足，一切形相无不圆满……”

segs.pali: ‘‘Āyatapaṇhi kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo…
segs.zh: “那位[[gotama|乔达摩]]尊者，足跟修长。

segs.pali: ‘‘Dīghaṅguli kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo…
segs.zh: “那位[[gotama|乔达摩]]尊者，手指修长。

segs.pali: ‘‘Mudutalunahatthapādo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo…
segs.zh: “那位[[gotama|乔达摩]]尊者，手足柔软细嫩。

segs.pali: ‘‘Jālahatthapādo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo…
segs.zh: “那位[[gotama|乔达摩]]尊者，手足指间有网缦相连。

segs.pali: ‘‘Ussaṅkhapādo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo…
segs.zh: “那位[[gotama|乔达摩]]尊者，足背高隆。

segs.pali: ‘‘Eṇijaṅgho kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo…
segs.zh: “那位[[gotama|乔达摩]]尊者，小腿如羚羊腿，修长圆润。

segs.pali: ‘‘Ṭhitako kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo anonamanto ubhohi pāṇitalehi jaṇṇukāni parimasati parimajjati…
segs.zh: “尊者[[gotama|乔达摩]]站立时无需弯腰，双掌即能触膝、轻抚双膝。

segs.pali: ‘‘Kosohitavatthaguyho kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo…
segs.zh: “尊者[[gotama|乔达摩]]的密处深藏不露。

segs.pali: ‘‘Suvaṇṇavaṇṇo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo kañcanasannibhattaco…
segs.zh: “尊者[[gotama|乔达摩]]身呈金色，肌肤犹如纯金般闪耀。

segs.pali: ‘‘Sukhumacchavi kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo. Sukhumattā chaviyā rajojallaṃ kāye na upalimpati…
segs.zh: “尊者[[gotama|乔达摩]]皮肤细滑。因皮肤细滑，尘垢不著于身。

segs.pali: ‘‘Ekekalomo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo; ekekāni lomāni lomakūpesu jātāni…
segs.zh: “尊者[[gotama|乔达摩]]一一毛孔，各生一毛。

segs.pali: ‘‘Uddhaggalomo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo; uddhaggāni lomāni jātāni nīlāni añjanavaṇṇāni kuṇḍalāvaṭṭāni dakkhiṇāvaṭṭakajātāni…
segs.zh: “尊者[[gotama|乔达摩]]体毛向上。这些向上生长的毛，青黑色，如眼药膏色，卷曲如环，向右旋绕。

segs.pali: ‘‘Brahmujugatto kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo…
segs.zh: “那位[[gotama|乔达摩]]尊者，身体如梵天之身，端直挺拔。

segs.pali: ‘‘Sattussado kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo…
segs.zh: “那位[[gotama|乔达摩]]尊者，身体七处丰隆饱满。

segs.pali: ‘‘Sīhapubbaddhakāyo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo…
segs.zh: “那位[[gotama|乔达摩]]尊者，上半身犹如狮子般宽阔雄壮。

segs.pali: ‘‘Citantaraṃso kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo…
segs.zh: “那位[[gotama|乔达摩]]尊者，他双肩之间饱满充实。

segs.pali: ‘‘Nigrodhaparimaṇḍalo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo; yāvatakvassa kāyo tāvatakvassa byāmo, yāvatakvassa byāmo tāvatakvassa kāyo…
segs.zh: “那位[[gotama|乔达摩]]尊者，他的身体犹如榕树般圆满匀称：身高与臂展等长，臂展与身高等长。

segs.pali: ‘‘Samavaṭṭakkhandho kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo…
segs.zh: “那位[[gotama|乔达摩]]尊者的双肩圆满平整。

segs.pali: ‘‘Rasaggasaggī kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo…
segs.zh: “[[gotama|乔达摩]]尊者的味觉最上殊胜……

segs.pali: ‘‘Sīhahanu kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo…
segs.zh: “[[gotama|乔达摩]]尊者的下颚如狮子一般……

segs.pali: ‘‘Cattālīsadanto kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo…
segs.zh: “[[gotama|乔达摩]]尊者具足四十颗牙齿……

segs.pali: ‘‘Samadanto kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo…
segs.zh: “[[gotama|乔达摩]]尊者的齿列齐整匀称……

segs.pali: ‘‘Aviraḷadanto kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo…
segs.zh: “[[gotama|乔达摩]]尊者的牙齿紧密无隙……

segs.pali: ‘‘Susukkadāṭho kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo…
segs.zh: “[[gotama|乔达摩]]尊者的牙齿极为洁白……

segs.pali: ‘‘Pahūtajivho kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo…
segs.zh: “再者，那位[[gotama|乔达摩]]尊者，舌相广长……

segs.pali: ‘‘Brahmassaro kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo karavikabhāṇī…
segs.zh: “再者，那位[[gotama|乔达摩]]尊者，音声如梵天，犹如迦陵频伽鸟鸣……

segs.pali: ‘‘Abhinīlanetto kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo…
segs.zh: “再者，那位[[gotama|乔达摩]]尊者，眼色绀青……

segs.pali: ‘‘Gopakhumo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo…
segs.zh: “再者，那位[[gotama|乔达摩]]尊者，其睫如牛王……

segs.pali: ‘‘Uṇṇā kho panassa bhoto gotamassa bhamukantare jātā odātā mudutūlasannibhā…
segs.zh: “再者，那位[[gotama|乔达摩]]尊者眉间生有白毫，洁白柔软，犹如棉絮……

segs.pali: ‘‘Uṇhīsasīso kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo; idampi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
segs.zh: “再者，那位[[gotama|乔达摩尊]]者，顶有肉髻；这也是那位[[gotama|乔达摩尊]]者作为大丈夫，所具足的大丈夫之相。

segs.pali: ‘‘Imehi kho, bho, so bhavaṃ gotamo dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇehi samannāgato.
segs.zh: “诸友，那位[[gotama|乔达摩]]尊者，正是具足这三十二种大人相。”

segs.pali: ‘‘Gacchanto kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo dakkhiṇeneva pādena paṭhamaṃ pakkamati. So nātidūre pādaṃ uddharati, nāccāsanne pādaṃ nikkhipati; so nātisīghaṃ gacchati, nātisaṇikaṃ gacchati; na ca adduvena adduvaṃ saṅghaṭṭento gacchati, na ca gopphakena gopphakaṃ saṅghaṭṭento gacchati. So gacchanto na satthiṃ unnāmeti, na satthiṃ onāmeti; na satthiṃ sannāmeti, na satthiṃ vināmeti. Gacchato kho pana tassa bhoto gotamassa adharakāyova iñjati, na ca kāyabalena gacchati. Apalokento kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo sabbakāyeneva apaloketi; so na uddhaṃ ulloketi, na adho oloketi; na ca vipekkhamāno gacchati, yugamattañca pekkhati; tato cassa uttari anāvaṭaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ bhavati. So antaragharaṃ pavisanto na kāyaṃ unnāmeti , na kāyaṃ onāmeti; na kāyaṃ sannāmeti, na kāyaṃ vināmeti. So nātidūre nāccāsanne āsanassa parivattati, na ca pāṇinā ālambitvā āsane nisīdati, na ca āsanasmiṃ kāyaṃ pakkhipati. So antaraghare nisinno samāno na hatthakukkuccaṃ āpajjati, na pādakukkuccaṃ āpajjati; na adduvena adduvaṃ āropetvā nisīdati; na ca gopphakena gopphakaṃ āropetvā nisīdati; na ca pāṇinā hanukaṃ upadahitvā nisīdati. So antaraghare nisinno samāno na chambhati na kampati na vedhati na paritassati. So achambhī akampī avedhī aparitassī vigatalomahaṃso. Vivekavatto ca so bhavaṃ gotamo antaraghare nisinno hoti. So pattodakaṃ paṭiggaṇhanto na pattaṃ unnāmeti, na pattaṃ onāmeti; na pattaṃ sannāmeti, na pattaṃ vināmeti. So pattodakaṃ paṭiggaṇhāti nātithokaṃ nātibahuṃ. So na khulukhulukārakaṃ pattaṃ dhovati, na samparivattakaṃ pattaṃ dhovati, na pattaṃ bhūmiyaṃ nikkhipitvā hatthe dhovati; hatthesu dhotesu patto dhoto hoti, patte dhote hatthā dhotā honti. So pattodakaṃ chaḍḍeti nātidūre nāccāsanne, na ca vicchaḍḍayamāno. So odanaṃ paṭiggaṇhanto na pattaṃ unnāmeti, na pattaṃ onāmeti; na pattaṃ sannāmeti, na pattaṃ vināmeti. So odanaṃ paṭiggaṇhāti nātithokaṃ nātibahuṃ. Byañjanaṃ kho pana bhavaṃ gotamo byañjanamattāya āhāreti, na ca byañjanena ālopaṃ atināmeti. Dvattikkhattuṃ kho bhavaṃ gotamo mukhe ālopaṃ samparivattetvā ajjhoharati; na cassa kāci odanamiñjā asambhinnā kāyaṃ pavisati, na cassa kāci odanamiñjā mukhe avasiṭṭhā hoti; athāparaṃ ālopaṃ upanāmeti. Rasapaṭisaṃvedī kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo āhāraṃ āhāreti, no ca rasarāgapaṭisaṃvedī.
segs.zh: “[[gotama|乔达摩尊]]者行走时，总是先迈右脚。他抬足不会过高，放足不会过近；行走不快不慢；行走时，膝不碰膝，踝不碰踝。他行走时，大腿不前抬，也不后压；不内并，不外展。[[gotama|乔达摩尊]]者行走时，只有下半身自然移动，而不凭仗身体的力量行走。那位[[gotama|乔达摩尊]]者转身看时，是以整个身体一齐转过来看；他不仰视，不俯视；行走时不东张西望，视线只看前方约一犁之远；由此，他具足无碍的知见。他进入村落时，身体不前倾，也不后仰；不蜷曲，也不歪斜。他在座位旁转身时，不会离座位太远，也不会太近；坐下时，不手扶座位，也不猛地将身体砸进座位里。他坐在村落中时，不会烦躁地摆弄手，不会不安地晃动脚；不搭膝而坐，不交踝而坐；也不手托下巴而坐。他坐在村落中时，不惊惶、不摇摆、不颤抖、不焦虑。他毫不惊惶、毫不摇摆、毫不颤抖、毫不焦虑，乃至毫毛也不竖立。[[gotama|乔达摩尊]]者坐在村落中时，恒处于远离的状态。他接受钵用水时，不把钵抬起，也不把钵放下；不把钵拉近，也不把钵推远。他所接的水不多不少。他洗钵时，不发出呼噜的水声；不把钵转动；不把钵放在地上再洗手；他洗手时，钵即干净；洗钵时，手即干净。他倾倒钵水时，不远倒，不近倒，也不随意泼洒。他接受饭食时，不把钵抬起，也不把钵放下；不把钵拉近，也不把钵推远。他所接的饭食不多不少。[[gotama|乔达摩尊]]者只用菜肴佐味而食，菜肴的分量不超过饭团。[[gotama|乔达摩尊]]者将饭团在口中翻转两三次后才咽下，不使一粒完整的饭粒未经咀嚼便进入体内，口中也不残留任何饭渣，然后才去接取下一口饭团。[[gotama|乔达摩尊]]者在进食时，能感受味道而食，却不贪著于味。

segs.pali: ‘‘Aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo āhāraṃ āhāreti – neva davāya, na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya, yāvadeva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya, vihiṃsūparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya – ‘iti purāṇañca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi navañca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi, yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cā’ti . So bhuttāvī pattodakaṃ paṭiggaṇhanto na pattaṃ unnāmeti, na pattaṃ onāmeti; na pattaṃ sannāmeti, na pattaṃ vināmeti. So pattodakaṃ paṭiggaṇhāti nātithokaṃ nātibahuṃ. So na khulukhulukārakaṃ pattaṃ dhovati, na samparivattakaṃ pattaṃ dhovati, na pattaṃ bhūmiyaṃ nikkhipitvā hatthe dhovati; hatthesu dhotesu patto dhoto hoti, patte dhote hatthā dhotā honti. So pattodakaṃ chaḍḍeti nātidūre nāccāsanne, na ca vicchaḍḍayamāno. So bhuttāvī na pattaṃ bhūmiyaṃ nikkhipati nātidūre nāccāsanne, na ca anatthiko pattena hoti, na ca ativelānurakkhī pattasmiṃ. So bhuttāvī muhuttaṃ tuṇhī nisīdati, na ca anumodanassa kālamatināmeti. So bhuttāvī anumodati, na taṃ bhattaṃ garahati, na aññaṃ bhattaṃ paṭikaṅkhati; aññadatthu dhammiyā kathāya taṃ parisaṃ sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti. So taṃ parisaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamati. So nātisīghaṃ gacchati, nātisaṇikaṃ gacchati, na ca muccitukāmo gacchati; na ca tassa bhoto gotamassa kāye cīvaraṃ accukkaṭṭhaṃ hoti na ca accokkaṭṭhaṃ, na ca kāyasmiṃ allīnaṃ na ca kāyasmā apakaṭṭhaṃ; na ca tassa bhoto gotamassa kāyamhā vāto cīvaraṃ apavahati; na ca tassa bhoto gotamassa kāye rajojallaṃ upalimpati . So ārāmagato nisīdati paññatte āsane. Nisajja pāde pakkhāleti; na ca so bhavaṃ gotamo pādamaṇḍanānuyogamanuyutto viharati. So pāde pakkhāletvā nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā. So neva attabyābādhāya ceteti, na parabyābādhāya ceteti, na ubhayabyābādhāya ceteti; attahitaparahitaubhayahitasabbalokahitameva so bhavaṃ gotamo cintento nisinno hoti. So ārāmagato parisati dhammaṃ deseti, na taṃ parisaṃ ussādeti, na taṃ parisaṃ apasādeti; aññadatthu dhammiyā kathāya taṃ parisaṃ sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti.
segs.zh: “[[gotama|乔达摩尊]]者受用食物时，是带着八项如理省思而进食的：不为嬉戏，不为沉醉，不为装饰，不为打扮，仅仅为了此身的存续与维持，为了止息伤害，为了助成梵行。他如此思惟：‘这样，我将消除旧受，不令新受生起，我将得以延续生命，无有过失，并安稳而住。’用餐之后，在接过钵水时，他不会把钵抬高，也不会把钵放低；不会把钵拉近，也不会把钵推远。他接取的钵水不会太少，也不会太多。他洗钵时，不会发出咕噜咕噜的水声；洗钵时，不会把钵转来转去；他不会把钵放在地上再洗手；在他洗手的同时，钵便已洁净，洗钵的同时，手也已洁净。他倒弃钵水时，不会倒得太远，也不会倒得太近，更不会四处泼洒。用餐之后，他不会把钵搁在地上过远或过近之处；既不会对钵漫不经心，也不会过分地执护此钵。用餐之后，他会默然安坐片刻，但不会错过随喜赞叹的时分。用餐之后，他会作随喜赞叹，既不会批评那餐饭食，也不会期盼别的饭食；他惟以教法的开示来教导、激励、鼓舞，令在场大众心生欢喜。他以教法的开示教导、激励、鼓舞，令在场大众心生欢喜之后，便从座起身离开。他离开时，不会走得太快，也不会走得太慢，而且没有急于脱身的样子；[[gotama|乔达摩尊]]者身上的袈裟，不会穿着得太紧，也不会太松；不会紧贴身体，也不会从身上滑落；风不会吹起[[gotama|乔达摩尊]]者身上的袈裟；尘垢不会沾染[[gotama|乔达摩尊]]者的身体。他回到园林后，会在铺设好的座位上坐下。坐下后便洗足；但[[gotama|乔达摩尊]]者并不沉迷于装饰双足的行为。他洗足后，便结跏趺坐，挺直上身，将正念安立于面前。他从不思维伤害自己，不思伤害他人，也不思伤害自他双方；[[gotama|乔达摩尊]]者安坐时，心中所念，唯是自身利益、他人利益、自他双方利益以及一切世间的利益。他回到园林后，于大众中说法，他不会奉承大众，也不会贬抑大众；他纯粹是以教法的开示来教导、激励、鼓舞，令在场大众心生欢喜。”

segs.pali: ‘‘Aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgato kho panassa bhoto gotamassa mukhato ghoso niccharati – vissaṭṭho ca, viññeyyo ca, mañju ca, savanīyo ca, bindu ca, avisārī ca, gambhīro ca, ninnādī ca. Yathāparisaṃ kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo sarena viññāpeti, na cassa bahiddhā parisāya ghoso niccharati. Te tena bhotā gotamena dhammiyā kathāya sandassitā samādapitā samuttejitā sampahaṃsitā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamanti avalokayamānāyeva avijahitattā . Addasāma kho mayaṃ, bho, taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ gacchantaṃ, addasāma ṭhitaṃ, addasāma antaragharaṃ pavisantaṃ, addasāma antaraghare nisinnaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ, addasāma antaraghare bhuñjantaṃ, addasāma bhuttāviṃ nisinnaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ, addasāma bhuttāviṃ anumodantaṃ, addasāma ārāmaṃ gacchantaṃ, addasāma ārāmagataṃ nisinnaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ, addasāma ārāmagataṃ parisati dhammaṃ desentaṃ. Ediso ca ediso ca so bhavaṃ gotamo, tato ca bhiyyo’’ti.
segs.zh: “再者，[[gotama|乔达摩尊]]者的声音具足八种特相：清晰、易解、甜美、悦耳、圆润、不散涣、深沉、洪亮。他用声音向在场的大众说法时，音声不超出大众之外。那些受[[gotama|乔达摩尊]]者以法语开示、激励、鼓舞、令其欢喜的人，从座起身后，一边离开一边频频回头凝望。朋友，我们见过[[gotama|乔达摩尊]]者行走，见过他站立，见过他进入村落，见过他在村落中静坐，见过他在村落中进食，见过他饭后静坐，见过他饭后作随喜，见过他前往园林，见过他回到园林后静坐，见过他回到园林后在大众中说法。那位[[gotama|乔达摩尊]]者便是如此，而且不止于此。”

segs.pali: Evaṃ vutte, brahmāyu brāhmaṇo uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā tikkhattuṃ udānaṃ udāneti –
segs.zh: 听了这话，婆罗门[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜从座而起，将上衣披于一肩，向着世尊合掌，如是三次发出感叹：

segs.pali: ‘‘Namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa.
segs.zh: “礼敬彼世尊、阿拉汉、正自觉者

segs.pali: ‘‘Namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa.
segs.zh: “礼敬彼世尊、阿拉汉、正自觉者

segs.pali: ‘‘Namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassā’’ti.
segs.zh: “礼敬彼世尊、阿拉汉、正自觉者。”

segs.pali: ‘‘Appeva nāma mayaṃ kadāci karahaci tena bhotā gotamena samāgaccheyyāma? Appeva nāma siyā kocideva kathāsallāpo’’ti!
segs.zh: “但愿有一天，我们能和那位[[gotama|乔达摩]]尊者相见，能与他交谈一番！”

segs.pali: Atha kho bhagavā videhesu anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena mithilā tadavasari. Tatra sudaṃ bhagavā mithilāyaṃ viharati maghadevambavane. Assosuṃ kho mithileyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā – ‘‘samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito videhesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi mithilaṃ anuppatto, mithilāyaṃ viharati maghadevambavane. Taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato – ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti. So imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti . So dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ, kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti. Sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotī’’’ti.
segs.zh: 那时，世尊在韦德哈境内次第游行，到达了弥提罗，便住在那里的摩伽天芒果园。弥提罗的婆罗门与居士们听说：“朋友们，那位从释迦族出家的释迦子[[gotama|沙门乔达摩]]，正与约五百位比丘组成的大比丘僧团一起在韦德哈国游行，现已抵达弥提罗，住在摩伽天芒果园。那位[[gotama|乔达摩尊]]者有这样的好名声传扬开来：‘这位世尊是阿拉汉、正自觉者、明行足、善逝、世间解、无上士调御丈夫、天人师、佛陀、世尊。’他亲自觉悟、现证之后，便向这个包含天、魔、梵天的世界，以及包括沙门、婆罗门、天人在内的世代宣说。他所教导的法，初善、中善、后善，义理圆满、言辞完备；他所示现的梵行，完全圆满、彻底清净。能见到这样的阿拉汉，实在是好！”

segs.pali: Atha kho mithileyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā appekacce bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu; appekacce bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu, sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu; appekacce yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu; appekacce bhagavato santike nāmagottaṃ sāvetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu; appekacce tuṇhībhūtā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
segs.zh: 于是，弥提罗的婆罗门与居士们便前往世尊所在之处。到了之后，有的人礼拜世尊，坐于一边；有的人与世尊互相致意，进行欢悦的交谈后，坐于一边；有的人朝世尊合掌，坐于一边；有的人在世尊面前通报姓名，坐于一边；有的人则默然不语，坐于一边。

segs.pali: Assosi kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo – ‘‘samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito mithilaṃ anuppatto, mithilāyaṃ viharati maghadevambavane’’ti. Atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo sambahulehi sāvakehi saddhiṃ yena maghadevambavanaṃ tenupasaṅkami. Atha kho brahmāyuno brāhmaṇassa avidūre ambavanassa etadahosi – ‘‘na kho metaṃ patirūpaṃ yohaṃ pubbe appaṭisaṃvidito samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkameyya’’nti. Atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo aññataraṃ māṇavakaṃ āmantesi – ‘‘ehi tvaṃ, māṇavaka, yena samaṇo gotamo tenupasaṅkama; upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ puccha – ‘brahmāyu, bho gotama, brāhmaṇo bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchatī’ti. Evañca vadehi – ‘brahmāyu, bho gotama, brāhmaṇo jiṇṇo vuḍḍho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto, vīsavassasatiko jātiyā, tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ, padako, veyyākaraṇo, lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo. Yāvatā, bho, brāhmaṇagahapatikā mithilāyaṃ paṭivasanti, brahmāyu tesaṃ brāhmaṇo aggamakkhāyati – yadidaṃ bhogehi; brahmāyu tesaṃ brāhmaṇo aggamakkhāyati – yadidaṃ mantehi; brahmāyu tesaṃ brāhmaṇo aggamakkhāyati – yadidaṃ āyunā ceva yasasā ca. So bhoto gotamassa dassanakāmo’’’ti.
segs.zh: [[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜婆罗门也听说了：“朋友们，那位从释迦族出家的释迦子[[gotama|沙门乔达摩]]，已到达弥提罗，住在摩伽天芒果园。”于是，[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜婆罗门带着众多弟子，前往摩伽天芒果园。当走到离芒果园不远处时，他心想：“我没有事先通报就去见[[gotama|沙门乔达摩]]，这对我并不合适。”于是，他唤来一位学童，说道：“来，学童，你到[[gotama|沙门乔达摩]]那里去；到了之后，代我问候[[gotama|沙门乔达摩]]，说他少病少恼、起居轻安、气力康健、安稳而住——就说：‘乔达摩大师，[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜婆罗门问候乔达摩大师少病少恼、起居轻安、气力康健、安稳而住。’你还应这样说：‘乔达摩大师，[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜婆罗门年迈、衰老、高龄，已到了人生的暮年，活至寿限的尽头，如今一百二十岁了；他精通三吠陀，兼明词汇表、礼仪书、音韵论、语词解说，以及作为第五支的古老传说，善于文句，晓了语法，对顺世论和大人相无不透彻。大师，在弥提罗的婆罗门与居士当中，[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜婆罗门被公认为最上者——从财富而言如此，从咒语而言如此，从寿量与声望而言也是如此。他渴望拜见乔达摩大师。’”

segs.pali: ‘‘Evaṃ , bho’’ti kho so māṇavako brahmāyussa brāhmaṇassa paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi. Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho so māṇavako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca – ‘‘brahmāyu, bho gotama, brāhmaṇo bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchati; evañca vadeti – ‘brahmāyu, bho gotama, brāhmaṇo jiṇṇo vuḍḍho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto, vīsavassasatiko jātiyā, tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ, padako, veyyākaraṇo, lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo. Yāvatā, bho, brāhmaṇagahapatikā mithilāyaṃ paṭivasanti, brahmāyu tesaṃ brāhmaṇo aggamakkhāyati – yadidaṃ bhogehi; brahmāyu tesaṃ brāhmaṇo aggamakkhāyati – yadidaṃ mantehi; brahmāyu tesaṃ brāhmaṇo aggamakkhāyati – yadidaṃ āyunā ceva yasasā ca. So bhoto gotamassa dassanakāmo’’’ti. ‘‘Yassadāni, māṇava, brahmāyu brāhmaṇo kālaṃ maññatī’’ti. Atha kho so māṇavako yena brahmāyu brāhmaṇo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā brahmāyuṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca – ‘‘katāvakāso khomhi bhavatā samaṇena gotamena. Yassadāni bhavaṃ kālaṃ maññatī’’ti.
segs.zh: “是，先生。”那位学童应允婆罗门[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜后，便前往世尊处。到了之后，与世尊彼此亲切问候。互致令人欢喜、值得忆念的寒暄后，他立于一旁。立于一旁后，这位学童对世尊这样说道：“乔达摩大师，婆罗门[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜问候您是否轻安、无病、身体轻捷、气力充沛、安乐而住；他又这样说：‘乔达摩大师，婆罗门[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜已衰老、年迈、高龄，生命步入后期，已达晚年，从出生算起，已有一百二十岁。他通晓三部吠陀，连同它们的词汇汇编、仪轨、音韵分解，以及作为第五项的历史传说；他是精通文字词句的文法家、教法家，于顺世论和大人相亦毫无欠缺。大师啊，在弥提罗城居住的所有婆罗门居士中，婆罗门[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜被尊为第一，论财富如此；于那些婆罗门中，他被尊为第一，论咒语知识如此；于那些婆罗门中，他又被尊为第一，论寿命与名声亦如此。他渴望见到乔达摩大师您。’”“学童，现在只要婆罗门[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜觉得何时适宜，便可前来。”于是那位学童回到婆罗门[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜处。抵达后，他对婆罗门[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜说：“[[gotama|沙门乔达摩]]已应允我们的请求。现在，先生，您觉得何时适宜，便可前往。”

segs.pali: Atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. Addasā kho sā parisā brahmāyuṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ. Disvāna oramiya okāsamakāsi yathā taṃ ñātassa yasassino. Atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo taṃ parisaṃ etadavoca – ‘‘alaṃ, bho! Nisīdatha tumhe sake āsane. Idhāhaṃ samaṇassa gotamassa santike nisīdissāmī’’ti.
segs.zh: 于是，婆罗门[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜来到世尊处。那时，众人远远望见婆罗门[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜正走过来，望见后便退让开来，为他腾出地方，正如对待一位有名望、有声誉者所做的那样。这时，婆罗门[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜对众人说道：“不必了，诸位！请你们就坐于各自的座位。我便在此沙门[[gotama|乔达摩]]身旁坐下。”

segs.pali: Atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi. Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo bhagavato kāye dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇāni samannesi. Addasā kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo bhagavato kāye dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇāni, yebhuyyena ṭhapetvā dve. Dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati – kosohite ca vatthaguyhe, pahūtajivhatāya ca. Atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi –
segs.zh: 接着，婆罗门[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜来到世尊处。他与世尊互相问候，互致欢喜、可忆念的交谈后，退坐一面。退坐一面后，婆罗门[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜便仔细审察世尊身上的三十二大人之相。婆罗门[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜在世尊身上见到了三十二大人之相中的多数，唯独两相未能得见。对这两相，他犹豫、疑惑，不得确信，未生净信。此二相即：阴藏相与广长舌相。那时，婆罗门[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜便以偈颂对世尊说：

segs.pali: ‘‘Ye me dvattiṃsāti sutā, mahāpurisalakkhaṇā;
segs.zh: “我曾听闻，大人具足三十二种殊胜之相。

segs.pali: Duve tesaṃ na passāmi, bhoto kāyasmiṃ gotama.
segs.zh: 然而，在[[gotama|乔达摩]]大师您的身上，有两种相我未曾得见。

segs.pali: ‘‘Kacci kosohitaṃ bhoto, vatthaguyhaṃ naruttama;
segs.zh: “人中最胜者，大师的隐秘处，是否如鞘所藏？

segs.pali: Nārīsamānasavhayā, kacci jivhā na dassakā .
segs.zh: 您有阴藏隐密之称，您的舌头莫非也不显露？

segs.pali: ‘‘Kacci pahūtajivhosi, yathā taṃ jāniyāmase;
segs.zh: “您是否如我们所闻，是一位广舌者？

segs.pali: Ninnāmayetaṃ pahūtaṃ, kaṅkhaṃ vinaya no ise.
segs.zh: “请您伸出那广长舌，为我们断除疑惑吧，圣者！”

segs.pali: ‘‘Diṭṭhadhammahitatthāya, samparāyasukhāya ca;
segs.zh: “为现法的利益，也为来世的安乐；

segs.pali: Katāvakāsā pucchāma, yaṃ kiñci abhipatthita’’nti.
segs.zh: “既蒙开许，我们请问心中所愿。”

segs.pali: Atha kho bhagavato etadahosi – ‘‘passati kho me ayaṃ brahmāyu brāhmaṇo dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇāni, yebhuyyena ṭhapetvā dve. Dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati – kosohite ca vatthaguyhe, pahūtajivhatāya cā’’ti . Atha kho bhagavā tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāsi yathā addasa brahmāyu brāhmaṇo bhagavato kosohitaṃ vatthaguyhaṃ. Atha kho bhagavā jivhaṃ ninnāmetvā ubhopi kaṇṇasotāni anumasi paṭimasi; ubhopi nāsikasotāni anumasi paṭimasi; kevalampi nalāṭamaṇḍalaṃ jivhāya chādesi. Atha kho bhagavā brahmāyuṃ brāhmaṇaṃ gāthāhi paccabhāsi –
segs.zh: 那时，世尊心中思惟：“这位[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜婆罗门观察了我的三十二大人相，除两项外大体得见，唯此二相尚有疑惑、犹豫，未能决定、不生净信——即阴藏隐密相与广长舌相。”于是世尊施展神通变化，令[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜婆罗门看见世尊的阴藏隐密相。接着，世尊伸出舌头，触摩两耳孔，触摩两鼻孔，又以舌覆满整个额头。然后，世尊以偈颂对[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜婆罗门说：

segs.pali: ‘‘Ye te dvattiṃsāti sutā, mahāpurisalakkhaṇā;
segs.zh: “你所听闻的三十二大人相，

segs.pali: Sabbe te mama kāyasmiṃ, mā te kaṅkhāhu brāhmaṇa.
segs.zh: 这一切都在我身上，婆罗门，请勿怀疑。

segs.pali: ‘‘Abhiññeyyaṃ abhiññātaṃ, bhāvetabbañca bhāvitaṃ;
segs.zh: “应证知者我已证知，应修习者我已修习；

segs.pali: Pahātabbaṃ pahīnaṃ me, tasmā buddhosmi brāhmaṇa.
segs.zh: 应断除的，我已断除，因此，婆罗门，我是佛陀。

segs.pali: ‘‘Diṭṭhadhammahitatthāya , samparāyasukhāya ca;
segs.zh: “为现法的利益，也为来世的安乐；

segs.pali: Katāvakāso pucchassu, yaṃ kiñci abhipatthita’’nti.
segs.zh: 我已给你机会，你尽管请问心中所愿之事。”

segs.pali: Atha kho brahmāyussa brāhmaṇassa etadahosi – ‘‘katāvakāso khomhi samaṇena gotamena. Kiṃ nu kho ahaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ puccheyyaṃ – ‘diṭṭhadhammikaṃ vā atthaṃ samparāyikaṃ vā’’’ti. Atha kho brahmāyussa brāhmaṇassa etadahosi – ‘‘kusalo kho ahaṃ diṭṭhadhammikānaṃ atthānaṃ. Aññepi maṃ diṭṭhadhammikaṃ atthaṃ pucchanti. Yaṃnūnāhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ samparāyikaṃyeva atthaṃ puccheyya’’nti. Atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi –
segs.zh: 那时，婆罗门[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜心想：“[[gotama|沙门乔达摩]]已给我机会。我该问[[gotama|沙门乔达摩]]现世的利益，还是来世的利益呢？”接着，婆罗门[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜又想：“我于现世利益已善通达，他人也常来问我此事。何不单问[[gotama|沙门乔达摩]]来世的利益？”于是，婆罗门[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜以偈颂向世尊问道：

segs.pali: ‘‘Kathaṃ kho brāhmaṇo hoti, kathaṃ bhavati vedagū;
segs.zh: “如何才能成为婆罗门？如何成为吠陀通达者？

segs.pali: Tevijjo bho kathaṃ hoti, sotthiyo kinti vuccati.
segs.zh: 尊者，如何方为具足三明？又如何方称学者？

segs.pali: ‘‘Arahaṃ bho kathaṃ hoti, kathaṃ bhavati kevalī;
segs.zh: “尊者，如何才称为阿拉汉？如何成为完全者？

segs.pali: Muni ca bho kathaṃ hoti, buddho kinti pavuccatī’’ti.
segs.zh: 尊者，如何是牟尼？佛陀又是如何被称说的？”

segs.pali: Atha kho bhagavā brahmāyuṃ brāhmaṇaṃ gāthāhi paccabhāsi –
segs.zh: 那时，世尊以偈颂回答婆罗门[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜：

segs.pali: ‘‘Pubbenivāsaṃ yo vedi, saggāpāyañca passati;
segs.zh: “他了知宿住，观见天界与恶趣。

segs.pali: Atho jātikkhayaṃ patto, abhiññā vosito muni.
segs.zh: 更证得生之灭尽，这位牟尼以证智圆满。

segs.pali: ‘‘Cittaṃ visuddhaṃ jānāti, muttaṃ rāgehi sabbaso;
segs.zh: “他了知心已清净，从一切贪欲中彻底解脱；

segs.pali: Pahīnajātimaraṇo, brahmacariyassa kevalī;
segs.zh: 断尽生死，梵行已立；

segs.pali: Pāragū sabbadhammānaṃ, buddho tādī pavuccatī’’ti.
segs.zh: 超越一切法，如此之人便被称为觉者。”

segs.pali: Evaṃ vutte, brahmāyu brāhmaṇo uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavato pādāni mukhena ca paricumbati, pāṇīhi ca parisambāhati, nāmañca sāveti – ‘‘brahmāyu ahaṃ, bho gotama, brāhmaṇo; brahmāyu ahaṃ, bho gotama, brāhmaṇo’’ti. Atha kho sā parisā acchariyabbhutacittajātā ahosi – ‘‘acchariyaṃ vata, bho, abbhutaṃ vata, bho! Yatra hi nāmāyaṃ brahmāyu brāhmaṇo ñāto yasassī evarūpaṃ paramanipaccakāraṃ karissatī’’ti. Atha kho bhagavā brahmāyuṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca – ‘‘alaṃ, brāhmaṇa, uṭṭhaha nisīda tvaṃ sake āsane yato te mayi cittaṃ pasanna’’nti. Atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo uṭṭhahitvā sake āsane nisīdi.
segs.zh: 如此说时，[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜婆罗门从座位起身，将上衣搭于一肩，以头面触世尊双足，以口亲吻世尊双足，以双手抚揉世尊双足，并自报姓名：“[[gotama|乔达摩尊]]者，我是[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜婆罗门；[[gotama|乔达摩尊]]者，我是[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜婆罗门。”那时，在场的大众心生惊奇，叹未曾有：“哎呀，尊者，这真是稀有啊！哎呀，尊者，这真是不可思议啊！这位如此知名、有大声望的[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜婆罗门，竟行如此极致的恭敬礼！”于是世尊对[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜婆罗门如是说：“好了，婆罗门，起来吧，坐回你自己的座位，因为你的心已对我生起净信。”[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜婆罗门便起身，坐回自己的座位。

segs.pali: Atha kho bhagavā brahmāyussa brāhmaṇassa anupubbiṃ kathaṃ kathesi, seyyathidaṃ – dānakathaṃ, sīlakathaṃ, saggakathaṃ; kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi. Yadā bhagavā aññāsi brahmāyuṃ brāhmaṇaṃ kallacittaṃ muducittaṃ vinīvaraṇacittaṃ udaggacittaṃ pasannacittaṃ, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā taṃ pakāsesi – dukkhaṃ, samudayaṃ, nirodhaṃ, maggaṃ. Seyyathāpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammadeva rajanaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya, evameva brahmāyussa brāhmaṇassa tasmiṃyeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi – ‘‘yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamma’’nti. Atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṃkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthusāsane bhagavantaṃ etadavoca – ‘‘abhikkantaṃ, bho gotama, abhikkantaṃ, bho gotama! Seyyathāpi, bho gotama, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya – cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti – evamevaṃ bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito. Esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca. Upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gataṃ. Adhivāsetu ca me bhavaṃ gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā’’ti. Adhivāsesi bhagavā tuṇhībhāvena. Atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi . Atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo tassā rattiyā accayena sake nivesane paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi – ‘‘kālo, bho gotama, niṭṭhitaṃ bhatta’’nti.
segs.zh: 那时，世尊为婆罗门[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜次第说法。即：宣说布施的法义、持戒的法义、生于天界的法义；阐明感官欲乐的过患、卑劣与杂染，以及出离的功德与利益。当世尊了知婆罗门[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜的心已堪任、已柔软、已离盖、已欢喜、已具足净信时，便为他开示诸佛所共赞的法教：苦、集、灭、道。正如一块洁净、无有污垢的白布，能完全吸收染料，同样地，婆罗门[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜就在自己的座位上，生起了远离尘垢的法眼：“凡集起之法，皆有灭尽之性。”此时，婆罗门[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜已见法、已证法、已知法、已彻入法，度越疑惑，远离犹豫，得无所畏，于导师教法中不依于他人。他对世尊说：“太殊胜了，[[gotama|乔达摩]]大师！太殊胜了，[[gotama|乔达摩]]大师！[[gotama|乔达摩]]大师，犹如将倾倒者扶正，隐藏者揭开，为迷途者指明道路，于黑暗中高举油灯，令有眼者得见诸色。同样地，[[gotama|乔达摩]]大师以种种善巧方便阐明了法。我今皈依[[gotama|乔达摩]]大师、皈依法、皈依比丘僧团。愿[[gotama|乔达摩]]大师纳受我为近事男，从今日起尽形寿皈依于您。[[gotama|乔达摩]]大师，请您与比丘僧团一同接受我明日的饭食供养。”世尊默然应允。婆罗门[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜知道世尊已经应允，便从座位起身，礼敬世尊，右绕之后离去。那一夜过后，婆罗门[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜在自己的住处备办了殊胜的嚼食与啖食，随后遣人告知世尊时候已到：“[[gotama|乔达摩]]大师，时候到了，饭食已经备妥。”

segs.pali: Atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena brahmāyussa brāhmaṇassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena. Atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo sattāhaṃ buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi. Atha kho bhagavā tassa sattāhassa accayena videhesu cārikaṃ pakkāmi. Atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo acirapakkantassa bhagavato kālamakāsi. Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ – ‘‘brahmāyu, bhante, brāhmaṇo kālaṅkato. Tassa kā gati, ko abhisamparāyo’’ti? ‘‘Paṇḍito, bhikkhave, brahmāyu brāhmaṇo paccapādi dhammassānudhammaṃ, na ca maṃ dhammādhikaraṇaṃ vihesesi. Brahmāyu, bhikkhave, brāhmaṇo pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti, tattha parinibbāyī, anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā’’ti.
segs.zh: 那时，世尊于上午时分着下衣，持钵与上衣，前往婆罗门[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜的住处。到达后，与比丘僧团一同在铺设好的座位上坐下。接着，婆罗门[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜亲手以丰美的嚼食与啖食，连续七天供养以佛陀为首的比丘僧团，令他们饱足满意。七日结束后，世尊便启程，于韦德哈国境内继续游化。世尊离去后不久，婆罗门[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜便命终了。那时，众多比丘前往世尊所在之处。到达后，他们向世尊敬礼，然后坐在一旁。坐在一旁的诸比丘对世尊这样说：“尊者，婆罗门[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜命终了。他往生何处？未来境况如何？”世尊这样说：“诸比丘，婆罗门[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜是智者。他法随法行，未曾以法义烦扰我。诸比丘，婆罗门[[Brahmāyu|梵摩]]瑜已断尽五下分结，现为化生者，于彼世界般涅槃，不来此世，不再从彼世界返回。”

segs.pali: Idamavoca bhagavā. Attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
segs.zh: 世尊如是说。那些比丘心满意足，对世尊所说欢喜信受。

segs.pali: Brahmāyusuttaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ paṭhamaṃ.
segs.zh: 《梵摩经》（第一经）终
